info.title: Hostly API
info.description: Gestão de reservas para aluguel de temporada

get.description: Answers 200 while the process is up, whatever the state of its dependencies. Use it to decide whether to restart the container.
Answers 200 when the API can serve requests (database reachable) and 503 otherwise. Use it to decide whether to send traffic to the instance.

post.description: CPF and phone are accepted with or without masks and stored as digits; the e-mail is stored lowercase. Answers 409 with code EMAIL_TAKEN or CPF_TAKEN when either is already registered.
Returns a short-lived access token (send it as `Authorization: Bearer`) and sets the refresh token in an httpOnly cookie. Wrong e-mail and wrong password both answer 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS.

Uses the refresh token cookie and rotates it. 401 codes: INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRED, REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED (the session was revoked because an old token was presented again) and REFRESH_TOKEN_ROTATED (a concurrent request just rotated it: retry once, the browser already has the new cookie). The cookie is cleared on every 401 except REFRESH_TOKEN_ROTATED.
Revokes the session of the refresh token cookie and clears it.

get.description: Sorted by name; `search` matches part of the name, in any case.

post.description: Address fields are optional; CEP accepts a mask and the UF any case. `building`, `block` and `unit` are for apartments only.

patch.description: Send only what changes; `null` clears an optional field. Turning an apartment into a house clears its apartment fields.

delete.description: Answers 409 PROPERTY_HAS_BOOKINGS while it still has bookings.

get.description: Sorted by name; `search` matches part of the name, in any case.

post.description: An individual (CPF) or a company (CNPJ, numeric or alphanumeric). Document, e-mail and phones are optional; masks are accepted and stripped.

patch.description: Send only what changes; `null` clears an optional field. The document must fit the resulting type (400 INVALID_DOCUMENT otherwise), so send it when changing type.

delete.description: Answers 409 BROKER_HAS_BOOKINGS while bookings still reference it.

get.description: `upcoming` (default): check-out today or later, soonest first. `past`: check-out before today, latest first. "Today" is in America/Sao_Paulo.

post.description: Amounts in cents, commission in basis points (1000 = 10%). 400 codes: INVALID_DATES, COMMISSION_WITHOUT_BROKER. 404 codes: PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND, BROKER_NOT_FOUND. 409 BOOKING_OVERLAP when the property is already booked on one of the nights; `details` names the booking in the way. The check-out day is free for a check-in.

get.summary: Bookings in a date window, for a calendar
get.description: Every booking with at least one night in [from, to), across all my properties or one of them. Not paginated; the window can span up to 366 days.

post.summary: Work out the money of a booking without saving it
post.description: For the booking form to show totals as the user types. Same rules and 400 codes as creating a booking: INVALID_DATES (order or more than 365 nights), DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_LODGING, PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_TOTAL and COMMISSION_WITHOUT_BROKER (send the chosen brokerId; it is not looked up). Amounts in cents, commission in basis points.

patch.description: Send only what changes. Amounts in cents, commission in basis points (1000 = 10%). 400 codes: INVALID_DATES, COMMISSION_WITHOUT_BROKER. 404 codes: PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND, BROKER_NOT_FOUND. 409 BOOKING_OVERLAP when the property is already booked on one of the nights; `details` names the booking in the way. The check-out day is free for a check-in. Removing the broker also drops the commission unless one is sent.
